args: Then set up CI so the docs tests run on every pull request.

This is a GitHub repository. Do you want me to add the Doc Detective GitHub Action, so these tests run on every pull request?

wrong.why: doesn't write the CI workflow it was asked for
tests only one of the two pages
sets up CI with a hand-written npx job instead of the Doc Detective GitHub Action

write..github/workflows/doc-detective.yml:
name: Docs tests

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npx doc-detective
